let value: number | string = 1;
const result = (value ??= 'fallback');
value += 'x';
console.log(value, result);
let explicit: number | string | undefined = 1;
if (explicit !== undefined) explicit ??= 'a';
explicit += 'b';
console.log(explicit);
let changing: number | string = 1;
changing ??= 'a';
changing ??= 'b';
changing += 'c';
console.log(changing);
class CoalescingAccessor {
  private stored = 1;
  get value(): number { return this.stored; }
  set value(value: number | string) { this.stored = typeof value === 'number' ? value : value.length; }
}
function useAccessor(obj: CoalescingAccessor) {
  obj.value ??= 'a';
  obj.value += 'b';
  return obj.value;
}
console.log(useAccessor(new CoalescingAccessor()));
function accessorResults(obj: CoalescingAccessor) {
  const first: number = (obj.value ??= 'a');
  const second: number = (obj.value ??= 'b');
  const or: number = (obj.value ||= 1);
  const and: number = (obj.value &&= 2);
  const bracket: number | string = (obj['value'] ??= 'c');
  const wrapped: number = ((obj.value) ??= 1);
  const asserted: number = (obj.value!! ??= 1);
  console.log(first, second, or, and, bracket, wrapped, asserted);
}
accessorResults(new CoalescingAccessor());
class AssertedAccessor {
  private stored = 1;
  get value(): number { return this.stored; }
  set value(value: number | string) { this.stored = typeof value === 'number' ? value : value.length; }
}
function coalesceAsserted(a: AssertedAccessor) {
  a.value! ??= 1;
  a.value += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
function orAsserted(a: AssertedAccessor) {
  (a.value!!)! ||= 1;
  a.value += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
function andAsserted(a: AssertedAccessor) {
  a.value! &&= 1;
  a.value += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
function bracketAsserted(a: AssertedAccessor) {
  a['value']! ??= 1;
  a['value'] += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
function mixedAsserted(a: AssertedAccessor) {
  (a.value!) ??= 1;
  a['value'] += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
class AssertedNullableAccessor {
  private stored: number | null = null;
  get value(): number | null { return this.stored; }
  set value(value: number | string | null) { this.stored = typeof value === 'string' ? value.length : value; }
}
function nullableAsserted(a: AssertedNullableAccessor) {
  a.value! ??= 1;
  a.value += 'x';
  return a.value;
}
console.log(coalesceAsserted(new AssertedAccessor()), orAsserted(new AssertedAccessor()), andAsserted(new AssertedAccessor()));
console.log(bracketAsserted(new AssertedAccessor()), mixedAsserted(new AssertedAccessor()), nullableAsserted(new AssertedNullableAccessor()));
